page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 203 at right. Below a rule: heading "XXX." and heading "RESPONSUM." Then one text column of the Latin response. Below the text, a block of smaller type (a note, set in a short column) with a catchword-like line "I 6" and "ciose" at the foot, which is a signature-style mark and the continuation word.

main_text.head: XXX.
RESPONSUM.
main_text.p: Quod Serenissimi & Potentissimi Principis ac Domini Henrici Regis Navarreni, &c. Legatus generosus & nobilis D. Jacobus Segurius Regiae domus praefectus & Princeps interioris Consilii ab Illustrissimo Principe ac Domino Domino Augusto Duce Saxoniæ, &c. Domino nostro Clementissimo ad Serenitatem Regiam perferendum tulit.
Serenissimo Regi Navarreno, Illustrissimus Saxoniae Dux Elector, pro egregia singularis erga se benevolentiae significatione gratias offi-ciose

page.notes: The small-type block below the text is a footnote-style annotation, read with uncertainty in its line ends. Words such as "Illustrissimus", "Elector" and "offi-ciose" are partly worn. The word "Duce" contains a possible Cyrillic-like letter; read as Duce. Marginal dots and specks are not text.
